sentences.en: The dynamics on this sheet music are all wrong.
sentences.zh: 这份乐谱上的力度标记全都不对。

sentences.en: Don't forget that families have their own internal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 别忘了家庭内部也有自己的动态关系。
